name: The Old North Road

layers.essential_history: [[c:This road follows the old line of the Great North Road through the north of Wansford, before the modern A1 was built to carry traffic past the village.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Traffic on the Great North Road made Wansford a busy stopping place for coaches, carriers and drovers for centuries.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:At the north end of the village, an ostler remembers Ned the guard asking where the river runs deepest. (Long walk only.)]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Head south, about 160 metres as the crow flies, to the old Great North Road.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
